What I think is interesting is that quite a few people can propose controversial topics, like @HardcoreHistory comparing Alexander the Great to Hitler or the Gallic Wars to the Holocaust, yet when feminists compare Greco-Roman rape myths to #MeToo it inspires incredible backlash.

@greekhistorypod To the fans: as a modernist I had no idea this controversy existed. As the USSR invasion of Prague led Marxist historians to reconsider if Communist uprisings were good, #MeToo has led classicists to reconsider women in antiquity. Not looking for controversy, but exploring one!
